positions.name: MissingIdSlugContract
positions.frame: what must the derive-id logic guarantee when a heading lacks an id field?
positions.why: src-1 names the exact production scenario being reproduced (a ## heading with no id field); src-2 states the behavioral contract required of the code under that scenario (no crash, valid slug produced). Both expressions share the same technical register and the same object — the missing-id case — read together as the correctness contract for derive-id: what condition triggers it, and what it must guarantee. No tension: the second follows from the first as its required outcome.
